what_current96_can_establish: Feasibility of each fixed action under the same declared historical-information policy, actual native execution and strict all-five-job comparison.
Complete sixteen-member fixed-initial and later-default references only when every member and incumbent are independently valid.
Full thirty-two-member finite optimum only for a completely valid case. An invalid member is not silently discarded.
The fixed-action campaign executes no optimizer. Its result table is offline evaluation data and must never enter a later policy.
remaining_model_obligations: Current pure003 and event-v2 projections assume a different collection schedule. Their saved completion vectors are diagnostic comparands, not predictions certified for the new policy.

A future predictor must model actual first versus fresh collection, immutable retries, delayed delivered ACKs and action eligibility; historical support can remove a fresh pair and move the return issue time.

Only current deciding-owner views, delivered peer snapshots, retained source-owned completion receipts and actual own immutable publication/selfACK history are available. No other owner's private endpoint, result table, case label or native fork may choose actions.
Completed prefix receipts, currently committed edges, generation/traversal and already-issued return actions remain immutable in every suffix candidate.
The two unsupported unloading transitions remain unknown until a lawful delivered terminal fact or independently justified observation contract exists. No additional retry or altered wire is implied.

fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.common_information: Each method receives the same captured public context at the same deciding-owner admission; all mutable current/ACK/union guards are rerun. Cross-owner readiness and agreement must be explicit, never inferred from central access to both views.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.common_initial_domain: The existing thirty-two legal fixed-action labels, including native_default as a policy rather than a promised edge. Every method may inspect unprotected internal proposals; deployment still requires the same declared protection decision rule.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.later_domain: At most the existing four return/later-route proposals before first return. Once return is committed, later proposals cannot change it; phase-B duplicate labels must have a predeclared identical caching/evaluation rule for every method.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.search_control: Freeze initial incumbent, deterministic ordering, tie handling, plateau visited states, stopping and caching rules. Ordinary MPC/LNS may warm start and traverse temporarily unprotected proposals under the same evaluation budget.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.deployment: Execute only the first currently lawful action, then replan using a newly delivered actual context. An updated preference ACK alone does not prove a changed EDGE_ENTER.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.protection: Point-model nonregression is a conditional proposal predicate, not physical proof. Actual comparisons require all five native terminal receipts and exact per-job <=0 against matched executed controls. No epsilon, unfinished-as-zero or missing-family promotion.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.cost: Charge complete request capture, copying, validation, context construction, every candidate, selection, command submission, delivered terminal handling, required continuation and output. Do not report a projection-only time as complete-request <=100ms.
fair_comparison_contract_to_freeze_befor.boundedness: Declare all branches and a shared wall budget before dispatch; retain unexecuted, failed, unknown and censored outcomes. No parameter retuning from a failed positive candidate.

next_decision_after_saved_audit: First diagnose the actual remaining unknowns and any timing deviations. Prepare a new predictor/information conformance contract only if it can represent that actual communication policy; otherwise report the specific information or lifecycle limitation. Do not rerun the full96 merely to fill a family.
claim_limits: Strong methods finding the same protected result is negative evidence for solver necessity, not a reason to weaken them.
A protected coupled causal mechanism does not establish new optimization novelty.
This synthetic five-job domain does not demonstrate original-airport business improvement or a general runtime guarantee.
